versions.localizedDescription: Follow-up to the landscape-orientation fix (ios-v0.4.2-orientation-fix): that build fixed which direction a landscape-only game launches in, but touch could still land in the wrong place, since the host was still telling SDL/UIKit that either landscape direction was fine even for a game that only supports one. That leaves the OS free to auto-rotate the actual presented surface to whichever way the phone is physically held; the picture still looks right (touchHLE rotates the framebuffer itself), but the OS then delivers raw touch coordinates in that other orientation, so taps land in the wrong

# Applesauce 0.4.1

Two fixes, both found by playing Peggle until it broke. Nothing about
installing or your library changes — pick the same IPA you used for 0.4.0.

## Games no longer hang at a full loading bar

The emulator's `wcstol` and `wcstod` only accepted a string that was *all*
number, where the real C functions read the leading number and ignore
whatever follows. Peggle reads its stage list exactly that way — the number
sits on a line with text after it — so the parse failed, Peggle threw away
every stage it had loaded, and the loading screen sat at a full bar waiting
for data that n

This TrollStore release fixes black screens in older OpenGL ES games.

The slow composition path now reads the app's current framebuffer. This preserves unresolved tile data on iPhone GPUs. The UIKit swap path now reattaches only the SDL view that it presents. This prevents a guest context from leaving the host drawable detached without causing alternating frames.
